subject: Stop the trial when T is exceeded.
rationale: The proposition is a prospective stopping rule with a coherent trigger and action: stop when workload exceeds the defined T. It presents an authored policy, without claiming that T is an empirically established harm-onset boundary. K09-S supports this form of prospective policy. The mapping describes reliance on C1 but does not establish C1's validity; this judgment does not assume that separate claim passes or treat contextual observations as substantive support.
